findings.location: probe_kit_scope.py check(): notAmended loop and inventory 'LINES' branch; S3-10, S3-7, DESIGN 3.10
findings.finding: The class path rule is enforced in one direction only. A file whose path_class() is non-None can be removed from notAmended.pinned and given line dispositions; it then escapes both the class check and S3-7's edited-pinned check. Planted P2 (task-packets/CONF-LIVE-003.yaml refiled as a LINES file with STATUS_LINE lines and added to the changed files) passes with no refusal. DESIGN 3.10 gives line dispositions only to supersedes files and to hit files 'in no class', so this record shape is outside the design. The concrete test 'nothing pinned is edited' is therefore not guaranteed by the model. The adopted record itself is classed correctly (my classifier: 0 differences).
findings.requiredChange: Refuse a LINES inventory row whose path is not a supersedes path and whose path_class() is not None (refusal 'class' or a new pinned text). Add the negative vector 'a classed file filed as a line-level file'.

findings.location: probe_kit_scope.py check(): sorted_unique(supersedes, key=id); DESIGN 3 'duplicate rows refuse [S1-12]'
findings.finding: supersedes uniqueness and order are keyed on the synthetic id alone. A row with the same path, lines, quote and items under a fresh id (S-46), linked from its moved rows, passes (planted P1). No check refuses two supersedes spans that overlap in one file. Every other list is keyed on content (staysTrue on path, lines and quote).
findings.requiredChange: Key supersedes order and uniqueness on (path, first line, quote), as the build sorts them, and refuse overlapping supersedes spans in one file. Add the negative vector 'a duplicate supersedes row under a new id'.

findings.location: probe_kit_scope.py check(): staysTrue and supersedes handling; DESIGN 3.7, S3-2, S3-4
findings.finding: The overlap protection depends entirely on the record's own staysTrue list. DESIGN 3.7 plus S3-2 fix the 12 spans exactly, but the model does not pin them. Unlike the model's pinned dispositions, unchanged ids, retiredHistory, deferred and placeholders, staysTrue is not fixed. Planted P3 (drop the PCR:191 staysTrue row and widen the PCR:190-191 quote over 'No new root key or signature role.') passes. So the brief's test 'no quote overlaps a statement that stays true' is not enforced. Likewise the 45 rows fixed by S3-2 and S3-4 are not pinned. P11 (drop the BH:36 row that carries the worker entry, recipes and receipt candidates, unlink it and relabel the line) passes. P10 (BH:36, covered by S-14, relabelled NOT_OWNERSHIP) passes because only QUOTED-implies-covered is checked, not the converse.
findings.requiredChange: Pin the 12 staysTrue (path, lines, quote) spans as model constants and refuse any difference. Refuse a line covered by a supersedes row unless it is QUOTED. Preferably also pin the 45 (path, lines, quote, movedItems, keptItems) rows, as the layer pins the decisions under S3-6's precedent. Add vectors 'a staysTrue row removed' and 'a covered line not QUOTED'.

findings.location: build_contract.py line dispositions (kind None and path not in supersedes -> STATUS_LINE); S3-15
findings.finding: Every hit line of a non-supersedes line-level file that is not in SPECIAL becomes NOT_OWNERSHIP STATUS_LINE by default, so the build cannot refuse a hit that fits no S3-15 reason. I read all 205 such lines in 57 files in context, for scope only. All are status tables or checkpoints, progress narrative, process prohibitions, index or ordering lines, and none assigns a moved item. HO:docs/alpha-2/CONFORMANCE_CONSUMER_CLOSURE.md:112 ('still precedes CONF-LIVE-003 draft12') fits ORDERING_PREREQUISITE at least as well.
findings.requiredChange: Enumerate the STATUS_LINE lines (or per-file rules) explicitly, so an unlisted hit refuses as S3-15 says. Optionally re-reason line 112.

findings.location: amendment.json inventory and row shapes; DESIGN 3.6, 3.10 (S2-7 shape {path, sha256, disposition, class, hitLines})
findings.finding: File-level PINNED and NAMED inventory rows have no class member (the class is only in notAmended). Line-level files use an extra file disposition LINES with a lines member. supersedes rows add id, the record adds base, and the dispositions, moved, retained and deferred rows carry extra members. These are reasonable, but the design does not hold them and the README does not document the closed shape.
findings.requiredChange: Add class to the file-level inventory rows, or record the deviation. State the record's closed member sets in the README.
